course_title: Physical Activity and Sport Leadership in Schools
course_description: This course aims to develop your knowledge, confidence, and capacity to lead programs of sport, physical activity, health and wellbeing within school settings (beyond Health and Physical Education). You will explore leadership identity and leading others, and decision making and advocacy. You will also analyse and design physical activity, health and wellbeing programs for schools. Additionally, you will participate in a practical physical activity program throughout the semester.

learning_activities.learning_period: Multiple weeks From Week 1 To Week 4 (27 Jul - 23 Aug)
learning_activities.topic: Leadership Identity & Leading Others This series explores the qualities of effective leadership. It supports you to identify and develop your own leadership identity by examining your values, leadership style and your school's strategic goals. You will also build your understanding to create and lead effective teams, including how to empower students to grow as capable and confident leaders. This series draws on both mainstream and First Nations Australian leadership perspectives. Learning outcomes: L03, L04, L05, L06, L07, L08

learning_activities.learning_period: Multiple weeks From Week 1 To Week 12 (27 Jul - 25 Oct)
learning_activities.topic: Managing Sport & Physical Activity Events in Schools This ongoing series focuses on developing skills in planning, organising and managing school-based sport and physical activity events. It integrates the Sport Education model and Fair Play pedagogies to promote meaningful leadership, teamwork, engagement and particpation in sport and physical activity contexts. Students will plan, lead, and participate in a engaging, inclusive and competitive tournament-style sporting event that showcases teamwork, organisation and positive sporting behaviours. This tournament serves as the culminating experience of EDUC2011. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L05, L07, L08, L09, L11

learning_activities.learning_period: Multiple weeks From Week 5 To Week 6 (24 Aug - 06 Sep)
learning_activities.topic: Outsourcing & External Providers This series examines how you can evaluate the value of external physical activity and wellbeing providers to determine whether they enhance the educational outcomes of your students. It supports decision-making by identifying gaps in programs and staff expertise, and by assessing alignment with school goals. It also builds your capacity to make informed decisions and confidently advocate for or against the use of external providers, as well as for staff professional development to strengthen practice and outcomes. Learning outcomes: L02, L04, L06, L07, L08, L09, L10

learning_activities.learning_period: Multiple weeks From Week 7 To Week 10 (07 Sep - 11 Oct)
learning_activities.topic: Program Design & Design Thinking This series introduces the Design Thinking framework to develop meaningful physical activity and wellbeing solutions for your school. It also explores strategies for using data-informed decision-making to advocate for your solution, maximise opportunities for implementation success and develop evaluation approaches that determine the effectiveness of your program. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05, L06, L07, L08, L09, L10, L11
